dedupe_keys.name: applywood a calculation tool supporting the design of plywood based seismic retrofitting interventions on existing timber floors

description: TU Delft researchers publish ApPlyWood to estimate the in-plane seismic response of existing timber floors strengthened with plywood panels. The described intervention fastens the panels around their perimeter to the existing sheathing. The software is intended to support preliminary engineering design and dimensioning of these retrofit measures. It is distinct from SimPlyWood, which supplies a macro-element representation for numerical finite-element simulation. Coverage: No geographic test site, evaluation date, input-file format or programming language is established in the reviewed metadata. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: GPL-3.0. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: Only the provider’s purpose and method description were reviewed. The software was not obtained or run, and its prediction accuracy was not independently assessed. Simulation uses include building seismic-response estimation and retrofit design. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
